provenance.method: Reuse the complete P0-59 and P0-60 committed byte corpora through SHA256-pinned manifests/containers. Rehash both whole IDBs; independently reread every selected range directly from IDAv6 uncompressed ID1 flags with a standard-library mmap/struct reader, taking the low byte at four-byte stride. No EXE, native code, game model, disassembler, or external repository script is executed by the composition source checker.
provenance.sourceClassification: Separate MOD-associated S1/S2 IDBs. Recorded EXE hashes are IDB metadata, not independently authenticated executables. Local byte equality never establishes stock, Vanilla, console, transitive hook, native runtime, or real-save equivalence.
provenance.priorExtraction: The prior corpora record separate trusted IDAPython/Capstone extraction and independent raw-ID1 readback. This composition adds a third direct raw-file reader; it does not need IDAPython.

provenance.byteReuse: No new machine-byte range is needed: the wrapper and getter were already extracted. Source-specific ranges retain their separate identities. Counts sum range lengths and do not deduplicate overlapping virtual addresses.
